# Controva LLC

> Controva LLC is an engineering-driven VoIP and AI Voice Infrastructure company. We build production-grade telephony systems (FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, SIP trunking, WebRTC) and AI Voice Agents / AI receptionist software for businesses that need reliable, low-latency, self-owned communication infrastructure instead of per-minute SaaS platforms.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Controva LLC
- Website: https://www.controvallc.com
- Contact: support@controvallc.com
- Areas served: Worldwide (remote), primary base in the United States
- Core expertise: FreeSWITCH & Kamailio development, custom SIP/VoIP architecture, BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) migration, SIP trunking and high-concurrency call routing, WebRTC and telephony app integration, AI Voice Agents, and AI receptionist software (including HIPAA-compliant configurations for medical practices).

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.controvallc.com/services): Enterprise VoIP engineering, FreeSWITCH & Kamailio integration, voice AI agents, WebRTC & app integration, and BYOC migration.
- [AI Receptionist Software](https://www.controvallc.com/services/ai-receptionist): 24/7 AI voice receptionist for inbound call handling, scheduling, and lead capture, including AI medical receptionist configurations.
